input: Apply for a remote work stipend from my employer

gold.taskTitle: Apply for Remote Work Stipend From Employer
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a remote work stipend offered by their employer to cover work-from-home expenses.

questions.title: What expenses does the stipend need to cover?
questions.description: Understand whether the stipend is for internet, equipment, office furniture, phone, or a combination of home office costs.

questions.title: Has your employer announced a formal stipend program?
questions.description: Clarify whether the employer has an existing, official remote work stipend policy or if the user needs to negotiate or propose one.

questions.title: Who is the right person or team to contact?
questions.description: Identify whether the application goes to HR, a direct manager, Finance, or through a self-service portal.

questions.title: Is there a specific application form or system to use?
questions.description: Determine if there is an online portal, PDF form, or email-based process the employer requires for submission.

questions.title: What is the deadline to submit the application?
questions.description: Find out if there is an open enrollment window, a quarterly deadline, or if applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

questions.title: Do you need receipts or proof of purchase to apply?
questions.description: Clarify whether supporting documentation such as invoices, receipts, or quotes must be gathered and submitted alongside the application.

questions.title: What is the stipend amount or reimbursement cap?
questions.description: Understand the maximum dollar amount available so the user can align their expenses and requests accordingly.
